title: Story premise ENT087: The Camera That Would Not Sit Still
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: The camera is doing all the acting. Takeaway/theme: Give the viewer time to read the action.
description: An animator wants a dramatic reveal but keeps orbiting the camera so quickly that the small character’s important gesture is invisible. They lock the camera for one clean shot, let the gesture finish, and reserve one slow move for the actual reveal of a huge birthday sign behind the character.
